column5: theorem coinBlock_eq (B i : ℕ) (r : List Bool) : coinBlock B i r = (r.drop (i * B)).take B
theorem decListFun_eq (Dc : List Bool → List Bool) (x : List Bool) : decListFun Dc x = (List.range (x.length + 1)).flatMap fun i => decListEmit Dc (decListStep^[i] x)
theorem padStr_eq (p : PolyExpr) (u w : List Bool) : padStr p u w = (w ++ List.replicate (p.eval u.length) false).take (p.eval u.length)

theorem wrap_coinLen (A : NUPPT) {pre post : List Bool → List Bool} (hpre : PolyTimeComputable pre) (hpost : PolyTimeComputable post) (β : ℕ → List Bool) (b : PolyExpr) (hβ : ∀ n, (β n).length ≤ b.eval n) (p : PolyExpr) (n : ℕ) : (A.wrap hpre hpost β b hβ p).coinLen n = p.eval n + A.coinLen n

theorem glPadInvFun_eq (T : TrapdoorCollection) (z : List Bool) : glPadInvFun T z = pairEncode (T.inv.output (NUPPT.layout (NUPPT.inParam z) (pairEncode (pairFstD (NUPPT.inArg z)) (pairFstD (pairSndD (NUPPT.inArg z)))) [] (NUPPT.inCoins z))) (pairSndD (pairSndD (NUPPT.inArg z)))

theorem multiDist_eq (Gen Enc : NUPPT) (n N Lc : ℕ) (m : Fin N → Fin Lc → Bool) (z : Gen.Coins n × (Fin N → Enc.Coins n)) : multiDist Gen Enc n N Lc m z = pairEncode (pairFstD (Gen.runAt n [] z.1)) (encodeList (List.ofFn fun i => Enc.runAt n (pairEncode (pairFstD (Gen.runAt n [] z.1)) (List.ofFn (m i))) (z.2 i)))
theorem outV_eq (π : Protocol) (P' : Strategy) (x y z : List Bool) (r : π.ExecCoins P' x) : π.outV P' x y z r = π.V.next x z (List.ofFn r.2) (π.transcriptWith P' x y z r).2

theorem transcriptWith_eq (π : Protocol) (P' : Strategy) (x y z : List Bool) (r : π.ExecCoins P' x) : π.transcriptWith P' x y z r = exec P' π.V π.verifierFirst x y z (List.ofFn r.1) (List.ofFn r.2) (π.rounds.eval x.length)
